In 1943, tanks of the Canadian Armoured Corps make their combat debut on the European mainland. This is the story of the Canadian tankers who fight their way up the Italian peninsula in the push to liberate Rome from Nazi occupation.

By 1942, Rommel’s Afrika Corps has been pushed back to Tunisia and the brash new US tank force lands in North Africa. This is the story of the final North African battles as two of history’s most famed tank commanders – Patton and Rommel – go head to head

After the success of the Blitzkrieg, young men across Germany flock to the armored corps in search of glory and excitement. This is the story of one young German tanker as he comes face to face with the harsh realities of armored warfare.

In 1967, in response to a growing threat by her Arab neighbors, Israel launches a pre-emptive strike against Egypt in the Sinai. This is the story of one of the swiftest and most dramatic victories in modern warfare.
Eager to regain territory lost six years earlier, Egypt launches a surprise attack against Israel in October 1973. This is the story of the final Arab-Israeli war in the Sinai.

Forged in the unbreakable brotherhood of the Marine Corps, Jason Dunham and his fellow Marines face a deadly ambush in Iraq. As they race into battle, a routine vehicle search erupts into a violent struggle that will change their lives forever.

In the chaos of war-torn Iraq, Marine Corporal Jason Dunham's fierce loyalty to his men is put to the ultimate test. Through gripping eyewitness accounts, his brothers-in-arms recount an extraordinary act of sacrifice and a desperate fight for survival.

As Jason Dunham's family faces an impossible decision, his fellow Marines confront the devastating loss of their brother. Years later, the true cost of his sacrifice emerges as one survivor battles PTSD, addiction, and the loss of his family.

Haunted by survivor's guilt and the invisible wounds of war, the Marines whose lives Jason Dunham touched struggle to find peace. Through family, brotherhood, and hard-won healing, they discover what it truly means to honor his sacrifice.
